body: Esta aula treina **ouvir e anotar informações (IELTS Listening, TOEFL Listening)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: A Seminar in Autumn
lines: The room smells faintly of rain and chalk;
a teacher, quiet, lets the question stand.
She does not lead, but helps the talk
along the way, a guiding, open hand.
Some speak too fast; some hold their words like glass.
She waits. The silence, patient, does its part.
And slowly, as the autumn light will pass,
the room begins to think with its whole heart.

items.q: The teacher answers every question at once.
The teacher helps the discussion move forward.
The silence is described as a waste.

body: **Let the question stand** — Deixar a pergunta no ar
**Draw someone out** — Fazer alguém se abrir
**Keep the conversation going** — Manter a conversa
**Open the floor** — Abrir a palavra
**Lead by example** — Liderar pelo exemplo
**Hold space for…** — Dar espaço para…
**A guiding hand** — Uma mão orientadora
**Find one’s voice** — Encontrar a própria voz
**What image opens the poem?** — Que imagem abre o poema?
**The smell of rain and chalk.** — O cheiro de chuva e giz.
**What does the poem say about teaching?** — O que o poema diz sobre ensinar?

lines: Teacher

The smell of rain and chalk.
O cheiro de chuva e giz.
Teacher
What does the poem say about teaching?
O que o poema diz sobre ensinar?

That a good teacher facilitates rather than dominates.
Que um bom professor facilita em vez de dominar.

items.label: Pausas e ritmo
items.note: Expressividade: varie altura, volume e velocidade para mostrar atitude; uma voz monótona soa desinteressada, mesmo com boas palavras.
words: That is NOT what I meant.

prompts.model: The poem suggests that good teaching facilitates discussion.

prompts.q: Quote an image and its effect.
prompts.model: “Words like glass” shows how fragile speaking feels.
It moves from description to reflection.

blocks.task: Write a 5-sentence analysis of the poem: theme, one quoted image, tone, structure, conclusion.
blocks.model: The poem suggests that good teaching facilitates rather than dominates. The image “words like glass” shows how fragile speaking can feel. The tone is calm and respectful. The structure moves from description to reflection. The ending, “the room begins to think”, makes the group itself the thinker.

body: AP/College: comece pela ideia central; sustente cada afirmação com citação curta e comente o efeito.
Não parafraseie o poema inteiro; interprete.
Verifique se a conclusão responde à pergunta do enunciado.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
